body.statement: Bonhomme--Dano--Graham Proposition 1 gives the sharp unrestricted-feedback program for the \(T=2\) predetermined-covariate binary-panel model conditional on \(X_1\), for a maintained heterogeneity support and reference measure.  Their continuous-support computations in Sections 5.1--5.3 use density representations and support grids.

source.verbatim_statement: Proposition 1 (Identified Set): theta-tilde is in Theta-I if, and only if, Q conditional on X1 has the displayed integral representation for some integrable functions psi_x1 satisfying nonnegativity, normalization, and the sequential restrictions (18). Proposition 1 shows that one can verify membership by checking feasibility of a finite- or infinite-dimensional linear program.

attestation.note: Author-posted NBER Working Paper 31027, revised July 2023, Proposition 1 and Section 5.1, pp. 14-15; transcription checked from the PDF on 2026-09-13. Sections 5.2-5.3 explicitly compute with discrete heterogeneity grids, including K=31 in the numerical illustration.

body.justification: This leaf carries only the published conditional-program and computation facts used in the repaired comparison lemma.
